author_or_institution: Jonathan M. Colmer, David Lagakos, and Martin Shu
title: Is the Electricity Sector a Weak Link in Development?
book_use: Chapter 4 counterevidence against treating electricity as the universal binding constraint on development; the paper uses electricity inputs and outputs for 100 countries and a multi-sector growth model to find smaller cross-country electricity-productivity gaps than aggregate-productivity gaps and only modest modeled long-run GDP gains from electricity-sector productivity or distortion reforms alone
